a11y: The lit layer is a clone the script builds — aria-hidden, with its links made unfocusable; the words themselves live once, in the dim layer. A decoration-forward part: never put copy here that exists nowhere else, and keep the dim layer a legible silhouette, not invisible.
description: A flashlight beam that follows the cursor across a dark panel. The words sit in shadow until the light reaches them.
title: Spotlight
usage: For hero panels and short lists that should feel like a torch in a dark room. Keep the copy short — the reader hunts for it, line by line. The beam rests at the top left until the pointer moves, so touch readers meet the panel already lit in one place.
